==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg yolk]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|confectioner's sugar]]

==Procedure==

# Break the egg yolk into a small bowl.
# Add the lemon juice and salt; [[Cookbook:Beat|beat]] lightly.
# Gradually beat in confectioner's sugar.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If you want extra-stiff icing, add a little more powdered sugar.
